attempts.rationale: The issue occurs because `strtol` reads beyond the bounds of the allocated string when processing numeric primitives. Specifically, when `strtol` parses a number like `-`, it may read past the null terminator into adjacent memory due to insufficient validation before calling `strtol`. The fix adds a check to ensure there is at least one digit following a minus sign before attempting conversion.
